Offline vault • No account or sync. Your selected CSV provider may store exports remotely.
CSV exports contain plaintext passwords. Protect exported files separately.

A forgotten master password or lost device-bound keys can permanently prevent access. There is no server reset. Optional biometrics keep master-password fallback. Encryption and secure windows cannot protect an already compromised device or every keyboard.
Development build for synthetic entries only. Release packaging is disabled.

Vault creation is disabled to preserve existing material. There is no automatic reset or recovery. Full app-data removal can also remove initialization evidence; this safeguard cannot restore missing entries.

Only synthetic prototype data can be reset here. This permanently deletes all Phase 1 entries and starts a new encrypted vault. Existing data will remain untouched unless you confirm. There is no automatic migration.
Choose a strong master password of at least 12 characters. Forgetting it can permanently lose your entries. There is no account, server, or password reset.
Protection is also tied to this device’s Android Keystore. Uninstalling, clearing app data, or losing device keys can make the vault unrecoverable, even with your password.
All plaintext prototype entries will be removed. Removal cannot guarantee erasure from flash storage. Continue only if these entries are synthetic and disposable.
Lock after app goes into background
Screen lock always locks the vault. File pickers follow the same background timeout.
